messages.subject: withProgress inside a mclapply
parts:
Hello,

I have been trying to track progress of a function using withProgress, however given processing times were too long I implemented a parallel function using mclapply. The progress bar used to work but now that I am using an mclapply it loads, then drops to zero and then loads again, making it impossible to track progress. Is there a another way to track progress when using mclapply?

Thanks!
Carlos
